employee_certifications_verification_com.name: employee_certifications_verification_complete
employee_certifications_verification_com.value:
("employee_certifications"."verified" AND "employee_certifications"."verified_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "employee_certifications"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL)
        OR (NOT "employee_certifications"."verified" AND "employee_certifications"."verified_by_user_id" IS NULL AND "employee_certifications"."verified_at" IS NULL)

employee_certifications_issued_not_after.name: employee_certifications_issued_not_after_expiration
employee_certifications_issued_not_after.value: "employee_certifications"."issued_date" IS NULL OR "employee_certifications"."expiration_date" IS NULL OR "employee_certifications"."issued_date" <= "employee_certifications"."expiration_date"

employee_position_compensation_amount_ma.name: employee_position_compensation_amount_matches_type
employee_position_compensation_amount_ma.value:
("employee_position_compensation"."compensation_type" = 'HOURLY' AND "employee_position_compensation"."hourly_rate" IS NOT NULL AND "employee_position_compensation"."hourly_rate" >= 0 AND "employee_position_compensation"."annual_salary" IS NULL)
        OR ("employee_position_compensation"."compensation_type" = 'SALARY' AND "employee_position_compensation"."annual_salary" IS NOT NULL AND "employee_position_compensation"."annual_salary" >= 0 AND "employee_position_compensation"."hourly_rate" IS NULL)

inventory_count_lines_variance_matches.name: inventory_count_lines_variance_matches
inventory_count_lines_variance_matches.value: ("inventory_count_lines"."counted_quantity" IS NULL AND "inventory_count_lines"."variance_quantity" IS NULL) OR "inventory_count_lines"."variance_quantity" = "inventory_count_lines"."counted_quantity" - "inventory_count_lines"."expected_quantity"

inventory_counts_approval_recorded.name: inventory_counts_approval_recorded
inventory_counts_approval_recorded.value: "inventory_counts"."status" <> 'APPROVED' OR ("inventory_counts"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "inventory_counts"."approved_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL)

inventory_transactions_direction_matches.name: inventory_transactions_direction_matches_type
inventory_transactions_direction_matches.value:
("inventory_transactions"."transaction_type" IN ('RECEIVE', 'ADJUST_INCREASE', 'COUNT_INCREASE', 'TRANSFER_IN', 'SALE_REVERSAL') AND "inventory_transactions"."base_quantity_delta" > 0 AND "inventory_transactions"."quantity" > 0)
        OR ("inventory_transactions"."transaction_type" IN ('CONSUME', 'WASTE', 'ADJUST_DECREASE', 'COUNT_DECREASE', 'TRANSFER_OUT') AND "inventory_transactions"."base_quantity_delta" < 0 AND "inventory_transactions"."quantity" < 0)

inventory_transactions_reason_required.name: inventory_transactions_reason_required
inventory_transactions_reason_required.value: "inventory_transactions"."transaction_type" NOT IN ('WASTE', 'ADJUST_INCREASE', 'ADJUST_DECREASE') OR "inventory_transactions"."reason_code" IS NOT NULL

purchase_orders_submission_recorded.name: purchase_orders_submission_recorded
purchase_orders_submission_recorded.value: "purchase_orders"."status" IN ('DRAFT') OR ("purchase_orders"."status" = 'CANCELLED' AND "purchase_orders"."submitted_at" IS NULL) OR ("purchase_orders"."submitted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "purchase_orders"."submitted_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL)

purchase_orders_cancellation_recorded.name: purchase_orders_cancellation_recorded
purchase_orders_cancellation_recorded.value: "purchase_orders"."status" <> 'CANCELLED' OR ("purchase_orders"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL AND "purchase_orders"."cancelled_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL)

modifier_inventory_effects_shape.name: modifier_inventory_effects_shape
modifier_inventory_effects_shape.value:
("modifier_inventory_effects"."effect_type" = 'ADD' AND "modifier_inventory_effects"."quantity" > 0 AND "modifier_inventory_effects"."unit_of_measure_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("modifier_inventory_effects"."effect_type" = 'REMOVE' AND "modifier_inventory_effects"."quantity" IS NULL AND "modifier_inventory_effects"."unit_of_measure_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("modifier_inventory_effects"."effect_type" = 'ADJUST' AND "modifier_inventory_effects"."quantity" <> 0 AND "modifier_inventory_effects"."unit_of_measure_id" IS NOT NULL)

modifier_groups_type_matches_counts.name: modifier_groups_type_matches_counts
modifier_groups_type_matches_counts.value:
("modifier_groups"."selection_type" = 'OPTIONAL_SINGLE' AND "modifier_groups"."minimum_selections" = 0 AND "modifier_groups"."maximum_selections" = 1)
        OR ("modifier_groups"."selection_type" = 'REQUIRED_SINGLE' AND "modifier_groups"."minimum_selections" = 1 AND "modifier_groups"."maximum_selections" = 1)
        OR ("modifier_groups"."selection_type" = 'OPTIONAL_MULTIPLE' AND "modifier_groups"."minimum_selections" = 0 AND ("modifier_groups"."maximum_selections" IS NULL OR "modifier_groups"."maximum_selections" >= 1))
        OR ("modifier_groups"."selection_type" = 'REQUIRED_MULTIPLE' AND "modifier_groups"."minimum_selections" >= 1)

order_discounts_removed_fields.name: order_discounts_removed_fields
order_discounts_removed_fields.value:
("order_discounts"."status" = 'REMOVED') = ("order_discounts"."removed_at" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("order_discounts"."removed_at" IS NULL) = ("order_discounts"."removed_by_user_id" IS NULL)

order_item_discounts_removed_fields.name: order_item_discounts_removed_fields
order_item_discounts_removed_fields.value:
("order_item_discounts"."status" = 'REMOVED') = ("order_item_discounts"."removed_at" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("order_item_discounts"."removed_at" IS NULL) = ("order_item_discounts"."removed_by_user_id" IS NULL)

order_items_send_fields.name: order_items_send_fields
order_items_send_fields.value:
("order_items"."send_batch_id" IS NULL) = ("order_items"."submitted_at" IS NULL)
        AND ("order_items"."status" <> 'SUBMITTED' OR "order_items"."send_batch_id" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("order_items"."status" <> 'DRAFT' OR "order_items"."send_batch_id" IS NULL)
        AND ("order_items"."recipe_version_id" IS NULL OR "order_items"."recipe_id" IS NOT NULL)

order_items_void_fields.name: order_items_void_fields
order_items_void_fields.value:
("order_items"."status" = 'VOIDED') = ("order_items"."voided_at" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("order_items"."voided_at" IS NULL) = ("order_items"."voided_by_user_id" IS NULL)
        AND ("order_items"."voided_at" IS NULL OR length(trim(coalesce("order_items"."void_reason", ''))) > 0)

orders_customer_name_takeout_only.name: orders_customer_name_takeout_only
orders_customer_name_takeout_only.value: "orders"."customer_name" IS NULL OR ("orders"."order_type" = 'TAKEOUT' AND length(trim("orders"."customer_name")) BETWEEN 1 AND 60)

orders_void_fields.name: orders_void_fields
orders_void_fields.value:
("orders"."status" = 'VOIDED') = ("orders"."voided_at" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("orders"."voided_at" IS NULL) = ("orders"."voided_by_user_id" IS NULL)
        AND ("orders"."voided_at" IS NULL OR length(trim(coalesce("orders"."void_reason", ''))) > 0)

recipe_versions_interval_matches_status.name: recipe_versions_interval_matches_status
recipe_versions_interval_matches_status.value:
("recipe_versions"."status" = 'DRAFT' AND "recipe_versions"."effective_from" IS NULL AND "recipe_versions"."effective_to" IS NULL)
        OR ("recipe_versions"."status" = 'PUBLISHED' AND "recipe_versions"."effective_from" IS NOT NULL AND ("recipe_versions"."effective_to" IS NULL OR "recipe_versions"."effective_to" > "recipe_versions"."effective_from"))
        OR ("recipe_versions"."status" = 'RETIRED' AND "recipe_versions"."effective_from" IS NOT NULL AND "recipe_versions"."effective_to" IS NOT NULL AND "recipe_versions"."effective_to" >= "recipe_versions"."effective_from")

reservation_table_assignments_removal_va.name: reservation_table_assignments_removal_valid
reservation_table_assignments_removal_va.value: ("reservation_table_assignments"."removed_at" IS NULL) = ("reservation_table_assignments"."removal_reason" IS NULL) AND ("reservation_table_assignments"."removal_reason" IS NULL OR "reservation_table_assignments"."removal_reason" IN ('REPLACED', 'CANCELLED', 'NO_SHOW', 'SEATED', 'REMOVED'))

reservations_cancelled_metadata.name: reservations_cancelled_metadata
reservations_cancelled_metadata.value: ("reservations"."status" = 'CANCELLED') = ("reservations"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("reservations"."cancelled_at" IS NULL) = ("reservations"."cancelled_by_user_id" IS NULL)

reservations_no_show_metadata.name: reservations_no_show_metadata
reservations_no_show_metadata.value: ("reservations"."status" = 'NO_SHOW') = ("reservations"."no_show_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("reservations"."no_show_at" IS NULL) = ("reservations"."no_show_by_user_id" IS NULL)

waitlist_entries_removed_metadata.name: waitlist_entries_removed_metadata
waitlist_entries_removed_metadata.value: ("waitlist_entries"."status" IN ('CANCELLED', 'LEFT')) = ("waitlist_entries"."removed_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("waitlist_entries"."removed_at" IS NULL) = ("waitlist_entries"."removed_by_user_id" IS NULL)

waitlist_table_assignments_removal_valid.name: waitlist_table_assignments_removal_valid
waitlist_table_assignments_removal_valid.value: ("waitlist_table_assignments"."removed_at" IS NULL) = ("waitlist_table_assignments"."removal_reason" IS NULL) AND ("waitlist_table_assignments"."removal_reason" IS NULL OR "waitlist_table_assignments"."removal_reason" IN ('REPLACED', 'SEATED', 'CANCELLED', 'LEFT', 'REMOVED'))

table_session_overrides_details_match_ty.name: table_session_overrides_details_match_type
table_session_overrides_details_match_ty.value: ("table_session_overrides"."override_type" = 'SERVER_SCHEDULE') = ("table_session_overrides"."server_employee_id" IS NOT NULL) AND ("table_session_overrides"."override_type" = 'CAPACITY') = ("table_session_overrides"."party_size" IS NOT NULL) AND ("table_session_overrides"."party_size" IS NULL) = ("table_session_overrides"."seated_capacity" IS NULL)

table_sessions_completed_metadata.name: table_sessions_completed_metadata
table_sessions_completed_metadata.value: ("table_sessions"."status" = 'COMPLETED') = ("table_sessions"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("table_sessions"."completed_at" IS NULL) = ("table_sessions"."completed_by_user_id" IS NULL)

table_sessions_cancelled_metadata.name: table_sessions_cancelled_metadata
table_sessions_cancelled_metadata.value: ("table_sessions"."status" = 'CANCELLED') = ("table_sessions"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("table_sessions"."cancelled_at" IS NULL) = ("table_sessions"."cancelled_by_user_id" IS NULL) AND ("table_sessions"."cancelled_at" IS NULL) = ("table_sessions"."cancel_reason" IS NULL)

employee_scheduling_preferences_hours_or.name: employee_scheduling_preferences_hours_order
employee_scheduling_preferences_hours_or.value: "employee_scheduling_preferences"."minimum_hours_per_week" IS NULL OR "employee_scheduling_preferences"."maximum_hours_per_week" IS NULL OR "employee_scheduling_preferences"."minimum_hours_per_week" <= "employee_scheduling_preferences"."maximum_hours_per_week"

employee_scheduling_preferences_day_limi.name: employee_scheduling_preferences_day_limits_valid
employee_scheduling_preferences_day_limi.value: ("employee_scheduling_preferences"."maximum_days_per_week" IS NULL OR "employee_scheduling_preferences"."maximum_days_per_week" BETWEEN 1 AND 7) AND ("employee_scheduling_preferences"."maximum_consecutive_days" IS NULL OR "employee_scheduling_preferences"."maximum_consecutive_days" > 0)

schedule_periods_published_metadata.name: schedule_periods_published_metadata
schedule_periods_published_metadata.value: ("schedule_periods"."status" = 'DRAFT') = ("schedule_periods"."published_at" IS NULL) AND ("schedule_periods"."published_at" IS NULL) = ("schedule_periods"."published_by_user_id" IS NULL)

scheduling_rules_day_limits_valid.name: scheduling_rules_day_limits_valid
scheduling_rules_day_limits_valid.value: ("scheduling_rules"."maximum_days_per_week" IS NULL OR "scheduling_rules"."maximum_days_per_week" BETWEEN 1 AND 7) AND ("scheduling_rules"."maximum_consecutive_days" IS NULL OR "scheduling_rules"."maximum_consecutive_days" > 0)

scheduling_rules_hard_limits_have_values.name: scheduling_rules_hard_limits_have_values
scheduling_rules_hard_limits_have_values.value: (NOT "scheduling_rules"."minimum_rest_hard" OR "scheduling_rules"."minimum_rest_hours" IS NOT NULL) AND (NOT "scheduling_rules"."maximum_days_hard" OR "scheduling_rules"."maximum_days_per_week" IS NOT NULL) AND (NOT "scheduling_rules"."maximum_consecutive_hard" OR "scheduling_rules"."maximum_consecutive_days" IS NOT NULL)
